channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: Adobe AVX2 Patch – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight tool that modifies Adobe installer files so they can be installed on computers whose CPUs lack AVX2 support.

item.title: ai-psd-thumbnails – File Management
item.description: Adds thumbnail images and preview support in Windows Explorer for Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, EPS, SVG and PDF files without requiring Adobe software.

item.title: Apex Radiance – Games
item.description: A visual and performance mod for The Sims 3 that adds advanced lighting, image effects, shaders and optional engine optimizations.

item.title: Compositor for Windows – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A Windows port of the open‑source Compositor image editor, offering layer‑based painting and basic photo‑editing tools in a single‑file project format.

item.title: dcc-mcp-core – Developer Tools
item.description: A control plane that lets AI agents communicate with creative software such as Blender, Maya, Unity and other tools through a shared protocol.

item.title: DRAW – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: DRAW is a pixel art editor that lets you create and edit pixel graphics and export them as source code.

item.title: Glide – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Glide is a fast Windows image viewer with multi‑tab and multi‑window support, offering many format decoders, overlays, and Explorer integration.

item.title: go2rtc – Networking Tools
item.description: A lightweight, zero‑dependency application for streaming video and audio from cameras and other sources on Windows.

item.title: GunWall – Security & Privacy
item.description: A free, open‑source application firewall for Windows that blocks programs from accessing the internet until you allow them.

item.title: HMBTN ReFarmed – Games
item.description: A native Windows port of Harvest Moon: Back to Nature that runs from your own game disc image with enhanced graphics and optional co‑op.

item.title: ImageMagick – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: ImageMagick is a free suite for creating, editing, converting and displaying digital images, supporting hundreds of formats.

item.title: Kooka Pictura – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Kooka Pictura is a layered photo editor that can open and save Photoshop PSD/PSB files and supports many common image formats.

item.title: MiBee NVR – Audio & Video
item.description: MiBee NVR is a lightweight self‑hosted network video recorder that runs as a single Windows executable and provides a web interface for live view, recording and AI detection of IP cameras.

item.title: NanaZip – File Management
item.description: A modern Windows file archiver based on 7‑Zip, offering a native Windows Store experience and additional features.

item.title: OBS Background Removal – Audio & Video
item.description: An OBS Studio plugin that removes or replaces the background in portrait video and enhances low‑light scenes using a neural network.

item.title: OpenDesign – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: OpenDesign is a collaborative AI‑powered workspace for creating motion graphics, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images and videos with your team and AI agents.

item.title: Patchy Image Editor – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: An open‑source image editor that aims for Photoshop‑compatible PSD handling and familiar Photoshop‑style workflows.

item.title: Pikado – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A free, open‑source browser‑based raster and vector image editor that works like Photoshop, with layers, masks, filters and adjustments, all running locally on your computer.

item.title: PMCA-RE RELOADED – System Utilities
item.description: A desktop toolkit that lets you view information, install apps, update firmware and edit settings on Sony cameras over USB.

item.title: ProperDim – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight screen dimmer for Windows that lets you set custom brightness levels, schedule changes, and use hotkeys.

item.title: Telescope – Audio & Video
item.description: Turns an Android phone into a webcam for Windows, supporting all lenses and offering manual camera controls, background effects and multi‑phone setups.

item.title: Win-Top – System Utilities
item.description: Win-Top is a lightweight Windows optimizer and system monitor that helps keep the PC running smoothly by managing memory, startup items, disk space and providing detailed process, GPU and port monitoring.

item.title: WristKey – Security & Privacy
item.description: Proximity auto‑lock and hands‑free unlock for Windows using an Apple Watch via Bluetooth Low Energy.

item.title: XR Gate – System Utilities
item.description: An open‑source runtime that lets Windows run VR/AR headsets and controllers that lack native support, providing 6DoF tracking, hand tracking and body tracking for SteamVR and OpenXR applications.

item.title: New7z – File Management
item.description: New7z is a free open‑source archive program for Windows that lets you create and extract many common formats such as 7z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZ, XZ, BZ2 and ISO.

item.title: PiPixiv – Internet & Browsers
item.description: PiPixiv is a third‑party client for the Pixiv art platform that lets you browse illustrations, manga and novels, view rankings, search content and download images on Windows.

item.title: Winstow – System Utilities
item.description: A Windows‑native tool that creates and manages symbolic‑link farms for dotfiles and configuration packages, similar to GNU Stow.

item.title: any_to_any.py – Audio & Video
item.description: Universal media converter that can convert, merge, concatenate and resize a wide range of audio, video, image and document formats on Windows.

item.title: ArSee – Developer Tools
item.description: ArSee is a free Windows tool that reads raw IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 traffic and shows it as readable frames, logs, and PDF evidence reports for testing and troubleshooting.

item.title: AudioSync – Audio & Video
item.description: AudioSync lets you play your computer's sound on multiple AirPlay, Google Cast, Bluetooth and other speakers at the same time, keeping them in sync.

item.title: AzioVoice Recorder – Audio & Video
item.description: AzioVoice Recorder is a modern Windows app for recording audio from any input device with optional filters and easy file management.

item.title: Basemind – Developer Tools
item.description: Basemind provides a code‑aware context and communication layer for AI coding agents, letting them query code structure, git history, documents and shared memory without loading whole files.

item.title: Brovan – Developer Tools
item.description: Brovan is a user‑mode x86_64 emulator that lets you run, trace and analyze Windows and Linux binaries on Windows, Linux and Android.

item.title: ClamAV – Security & Privacy
item.description: ClamAV is an open‑source antivirus engine that scans for viruses, trojans, malware and other malicious threats.

item.title: ClipTyper – System Utilities
item.description: Types clipboard text as keystrokes when pasting is not possible, such as in VM consoles, iLO/iDRAC, and remote sessions without a shared clipboard.

item.title: DMR Studio – Audio & Video
item.description: DMR Studio is a Windows desktop program that automatically records livestreams, captures and renders chat comments (danmaku), manages recording tasks and can upload the finished videos.

item.title: Docbank – Productivity & Office
item.description: Docbank is an open‑source local document vault that stores PDFs, images, text files and other records, makes their text searchable, tracks versions and lets you export verified bundles.

item.title: DYGTube – Audio & Video
item.description: Download MP3 and MP4 files from online video services using a simple Windows interface.

item.title: ED Unofficial Patch – Games
item.description: Unofficial fixes and DLSS, FSR and XeSS upscaling for Elite Dangerous: Odyssey, in VR and flat

item.title: File 2 Startup – System Utilities
item.description: A desktop application that lets you add, edit, and remove executable files from the Windows startup list easily.

item.title: File Converter Pro – File Management
item.description: Free offline all‑in‑one file converter for Windows that handles documents, images, audio and video without uploading anything.

item.title: FluentControl – System Utilities
item.description: A Windows tool that lets you control monitor brightness, contrast, color settings, input source, system volume, microphone and mouse speed from a single panel, with support for multiple monitors and offline use.

item.title: Foundation Sunshine – Games
item.description: Foundation Sunshine is a free open‑source remote streaming host that lets you view and control your Windows desktop, applications and games from another device with low latency, HDR and controller support.

item.title: Homura – Productivity & Office
item.description: Homura is a local comic, light‑novel and ebook reader for Windows that supports many formats and keeps your reading data on the device.

item.title: Hydra Dragon Antivirus – Security & Privacy
item.description: An open‑source antivirus and endpoint detection and response tool that combines ClamAV, YARA, machine‑learning analysis and other security components for Windows.

item.title: iMA Menu – System Utilities
item.description: iMA Menu adds customizable context‑menu items, theming and a set of handy tools to the Windows desktop.

item.title: IME Mode Persistence – System Utilities
item.description: A small Windows tray utility that remembers the last input method conversion mode (Chinese/English) when switching windows and can lock specific programs to a chosen input language, even for fullscreen games.

item.title: Last Wallpaper – System Utilities
item.description: Shows a picture‑of‑the‑day on your desktop from sources such as Bing, NASA, Wikipedia, Copernicus and more.

item.title: LibreSVIP – File Management
item.description: A universal converter for many Singing Voice Synthesis project formats.

item.title: MiniDock – System Utilities
item.description: MiniDock provides a lightweight Dock and a macOS‑style top status bar for Windows, letting you keep frequently used apps, windows, and system information easily accessible.
